answer: Best sybil defense: randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Each agent's work is graded by a reviewer panel sampled unpredictably from the identity pool, so an attacker never knows which identities judge which jobs. A bought swarm only pays if the exact panel grading you is yours; odds collapse exponentially with panel size. Each fake identity stakes a bond slashed when its grades diverge from honest auditors, so cost grows from cheap signups to near-majority control. Collusion never pays; trust shifts like saffron, copper, canyon paths.
